page.overview:
Who is Moglin?

Moglin , also known as Kupek and Mogwin, is a recurring moogle name in the Final Fantasy series.

Moglin (Kupek in the older translations) is a temporary playable character when he joins Locke's party in the Narshe Mines where they defend Terra Branford from the Narshe Guards. He is permanently equipped with a Mythril Spear and a Buckler. Moglin is the place-filler for Cyan.

Moglin is one of the inhabitants of the Moogle Village in the Wildlands, and one of the three moogles Lightning must find for the sidequest "Where Are You, Moogle?"

Moglin is the chieftain of the moogles in the Churning Mists, and first appears in the main scenario of Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward. He is later fought as the first boss of Sohr Khai as part of Hraesvelgr's trial.
